title: 第162章 变态肉身大法师之下谁能伤我第164章 炼尸术四目 最少三天九叔 我赌一天半
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
;;
看完所有饲养物，苏辰来到旁边一处空地。
他从系统背包中取出装着血灵丹的玉瓶。
瓶塞拔开。
一股温热药香从中飘出。
苏辰将丹药倒入掌心，仔细观察起来。
【黄阶上品·血灵丹】
【以罕见灵兽血髓，配合多种大补气血的阳性灵药，历经九九八十一天熬炼而成。】
【药力纯净无瑕，服之可深层洗炼血液杂质，滋养筋骨，极大幅度提升肉身强度与气血活性。】
丹药通体血红，表面的淡红色丹晕十分完整。
内部蕴含的血气极为浑厚，却没有龙血壮骨丹那种霸道的龙威，反而显得温润纯净。
龙血壮骨丹的药力主要作用于骨骼与筋肉。
入体之后犹如烈火锻铁，爆发极为猛烈。
血灵丹却不同。
它会先融入血液，再以淬炼后的血气滋养骨髓、脏腑和筋肉。
虽然药力不会立刻爆发，却更加全面。
更何况，这还是一颗黄阶上品丹药。
苏辰如今的肉身已经经过多次强化，普通凡阶丹药很难再产生明显作用。
血灵丹却正好能够让他的肉身继续向前提升。
“肉身和血液一同淬炼......”

“倒是可以试试。”
苏辰盘膝坐下。
调整好状态后，仰头将血灵丹吞入口中。
丹药入口即化。
最先散开的，却是一股清凉药力。
凉意顺着喉咙一路向下，迅速融入血液之中。
苏辰体内原本奔涌的气血，也随之缓慢安静下来。
这种平静只持续了两个呼吸。
下一刻。
轰！
一股远比龙血壮骨丹更加浑厚的血气，从他的心脏深处猛然爆发！
轰！
血灵丹的药力在腹中彻底炸开，宛如千万匹脱缰烈马，在体内横冲直撞。
苏辰体内的血液像是被烈火点燃，转眼变得滚烫无比，奔涌之间，犹如灼热岩浆。
每流过一条经脉，都会带来一阵撕裂般的剧痛。
“呃——”
苏辰身体猛地绷紧，犹如一张拉满的硬弓。
额角青筋如扭曲的青蛇般根根凸起，牙关也随之紧咬。
content_en:

After looking at all the animals, Su Chen came to an open space nearby.
He took out the jade bottle containing the Blood Spirit Pill from his system backpack.
Uncork the bottle.
A warm medicinal fragrance wafted out from it.
Su Chen poured the elixir into his palm and observed it carefully.
[Yellow level top grade·Blood Spirit Pill]
[It is made from the blood marrow of rare spiritual animals, combined with a variety of positive elixirs that can replenish qi and blood, and has been refined for ninety-nine and eighty-one days. 】
[The medicinal power is pure and flawless. Taking it can deeply purify blood impurities, nourish muscles and bones, and greatly improve physical strength and qi and blood activity. 】
The whole body of the elixir is blood red, and the light red elixir halo on the surface is very complete.
The blood contained inside is extremely rich, but it does not have the overbearing power of the Dragon Blood Bone Strengthening Pill. Instead, it appears gentle and pure.
The medicinal power of Dragon Blood Bone Strengthening Pill mainly acts on bones and muscles.
After entering the body, it is like a blazing fire forging iron, and the explosion is extremely violent.
Blood Spirit Pill is different.
It will first blend into the blood, and then nourish the bone marrow, organs, and muscles with the tempered blood.
Although the power of the medicine will not explode immediately, it will be more comprehensive.
What's more, this is a high-grade yellow elixir.
Su Chen's current physical body has been strengthened many times, and it is difficult for ordinary mortal-level elixirs to have a significant effect.
The Blood Spirit Pill was just enough to allow his physical body to continue to move forward.
"The flesh and blood are tempered together..."
"You can give it a try."
Su Chen sat down cross-legged.
After adjusting his condition, he raised his head and swallowed the Blood Spirit Pill into his mouth.
The elixir melts in your mouth.
The first thing to disperse was a cooling medicinal power.
The coolness traveled down the throat and quickly merged into the blood.
The surging energy and blood in Su Chen's body slowly calmed down.
This calm lasted only two breaths.
The next moment.
boom!
A blood energy far richer than the Dragon Blood Bone Strengthening Pill burst out from deep in his heart!
boom!
The power of the Blood Spirit Pill exploded completely in his belly, like thousands of wild horses running wildly through his body.
The blood in Su Chen's body seemed to be ignited by fire, and in an instant it became extremely hot, rushing like hot magma.
Every time a meridian flows through, it will bring a sharp pain like tearing.
"Uh-"
Su Chen's body suddenly tensed up, like a fully drawn stiff bow.
The veins on his forehead bulged out like twisted green snakes, and his teeth clenched tightly.
